verses.geez: ተዘከሮ፡ ለፈጣሪከ፡ በመዋዕለ፡ ውርዙትከ፡ ዘእንበለ፡ ይምጻእከ፡ መዋዕል፡ እኩይ፡ ወይብጽሓ፡ ዓመታት፡ በዕለተ፡ ትብል፡ ኢኮነኒ፡ ዘንተ፡ ፈቃድየ።
verses.translation: And remember thy Creator in the days of thy youth, before the days of evil come, and the years overtake thee in which thou shalt say, I have no pleasure in them.

translations.lxx: And remember thy Creator in the days of thy youth, before the days of evil come, and the years overtake thee in which thou shalt say, I have no pleasure in them.
translations.kjv: Remember now thy Creator in the days of thy youth, while the evil days come not, nor the years draw nigh, when thou shalt say, I have no pleasure in them;
translations.ron: Adu-ţi aminte de Ziditorul tău în zilele tinereţii tale, înainte ca să vină zilele de restrişte şi să se apropie anii despre care vei zice: "N-am nici o plăcere de ei ..."
translations.grk: Καὶ μνήσθητι τοῦ κτίσαντός σε ἐν ἡμέραις νεότητός σου, ἕως ὅτου μὴ ἔλθωσιν αἱ ἡμέραι τῆς κακίας, καὶ φθάσουσιν ἔτη ἐν οἷς ἐρεῖς, οὐκ ἔστι μοι ἐν αὐτοῖς θέλημα.

verses.geez: ዘእንበለ፡ ይጽልም፡ ፀሐይ፡ ወብርሃነ፡ ወርኅ፡ ወከዋክብት፡ ወዘእንበለ፡ ይትመየጡ፡ ደመናት፡ ድኅረ፡ ዝናማት።
verses.translation: While the sun and light are not darkened, nor the moon and the stars; nor the clouds return after the rain:

translations.lxx: While the sun and light are not darkened, nor the moon and the stars; nor the clouds return after the rain:
translations.kjv: While the sun, or the light, or the moon, or the stars, be not darkened, nor the clouds return after the rain:
translations.ron: Înainte ca să se întunece soarele şi lumina şi luna şi stelele şi ca norii să mai vină după ploaie;
translations.grk: Ἕως οὗ μὴ σκοτισθῇ ὁ ἥλιος καὶ τὸ φῶς, καὶ ἡ σελήνη καὶ οἱ ἀστέρες, καὶ ἐπιστρέψουσι τὰ νέφη ὀπίσω τοῦ ὑετοῦ.

verses.geez: አመ፡ ዕለተ፡ ያንቀለቅሉ፡ ዓቃብያነ፡ ቤት፡ ወይትዓለዉ፡ ሰብእ፡ ኀላይያት፡ ወተፀርዓ፡ እለ፡ የሐርፃ፡ እስመ፡ ድኩማት፡ እማንቱ፡ ወይጽልማ፡ እለ፡ ይሬእያ፡ በጸዳል።
verses.translation: in the day wherein the keepers of the house shall tremble, and the mighty men shall become bent, and the grinding women cease because they have become few, and the women looking out at the windows be dark;

translations.lxx: in the day wherein the keepers of the house shall tremble, and the mighty men shall become bent, and the grinding women cease because they have become few, and the women looking out at the windows be dark;
translations.kjv: In the day when the keepers of the house shall tremble, and the strong men shall bow themselves, and the grinders cease because they are few, and those that look out of the windows be darkened,
translations.ron: Atunci este vremea când străjerii casei tremură şi oamenii cei tari se încovoaie la pământ şi cele ce macină nu mai lucrează, căci sunt puţine la număr şi privitoarele de la ferestre se întunecă;
translations.grk: Ἐν ἡμέρᾳ ᾗ ἐὰν σαλευθῶσι φύλακες τῆς οἰκίας, καὶ διαστραφῶσιν ἄνδρες τῆς δυνάμεως, καὶ ἤργησαν αἱ ἀλήθουσαι ὅτι ὠλιγώθησαν, καὶ σκοτάσουσιν αἱ βλέπουσαι ἐν ταῖς ὀπαῖς·

verses.geez: ወይትዐፀው፡ ኆኅት፡ በምሥያጣት፡ በድውይ፡ ቃል፡ እንተ፡ ተሐርፅ፡ ወትትነሣእ፡ በቃለ፡ ዖፍ፡ ወየኃሥራ፡ ኵሎን፡ አዋልደ፡ ማኅሌት።
verses.translation: and they shall shut the doors in the market-place, because of the weakness of the voice of her that grinds at the mill; and he shall rise up at the voice of the sparrow, and all the daughters of song shall be brought low;

translations.lxx: and they shall shut the doors in the market-place, because of the weakness of the voice of her that grinds at the mill; and he shall rise up at the voice of the sparrow, and all the daughters of song shall be brought low;
translations.kjv: And the doors shall be shut in the streets, when the sound of the grinding is low, and he shall rise up at the voice of the bird, and all the daughters of musick shall be brought low;
translations.ron: Şi se închid porţile care dau spre uliţă şi se domoleşte huruitul morii şi te scoli la ciripitul de dimineaţă al păsării şi se potolesc toate cântăreţele;
translations.grk: Καὶ κλείσουσι θύρας ἐν ἀγορᾷ, ἐν ἀσθενείᾳ φωνῆς τῆς ἀληθούσης· καὶ ἀναστήσεται εἰς φωνὴν τοῦ στρουθίου, καὶ ταπεινωθήσονται πᾶσαι αἱ θυγατέρες τοῦ ᾄσματος·

verses.geez: እስመ፡ እመልዕልት፡ ይሬእዩ፡ ድንጋፄ፡ በውስተ፡ ፍኖት፡ ወይጸጊ፡ ከርካዕ፡ ወይገዝፍ፡ አንቦጣ፡ ወይትፈረዘዝ፡ ቊልሕ፡ አመ፡ ሖረ፡ ብእሲ፡ ውስተ፡ ቤተ፡ ዓለሙ፡ ወዓዲ፡ ጽጐ፡ እለ፡ ይላህዉ።
verses.translation: and they shall look up, and fears shall be in the way, and the almond tree shall blossom, and the locust shall increase, and the caper shall be scattered: because man has gone to his eternal home, and the mourners have gone about the market:

translations.lxx: and they shall look up, and fears shall be in the way, and the almond tree shall blossom, and the locust shall increase, and the caper shall be scattered: because man has gone to his eternal home, and the mourners have gone about the market:
translations.kjv: Also when they shall be afraid of that which is high, and fears shall be in the way, and the almond tree shall flourish, and the grasshopper shall be a burden, and desire shall fail: because man goeth to his long home, and the mourners go about the streets:
translations.ron: Şi te temi să mai urci colina şi spaimele pândesc în cale şi capul se face alb ca floarea de migdal şi lăcusta sprintenă se face grea şi toţi mugurii s-au deschis, fiindcă omul merge la locaşul său de veci şi bocitoarele dau târcoale pe uliţă;
translations.grk: Καὶ εἰς τὸ ὕψος ὄψονται, καὶ θάμβοι ἐν τῇ ὁδῷ, καὶ ἀνθήσῃ τὸ ἀμύγδαλον, καὶ παχυνθῇ ἡ ἀκρὶς, καὶ διασκεδασθῇ ἡ κάππαρις, ὅτι ἐπορεύθη ὁ ἄνθρωπος εἰς οἶκον αἰῶνος αὐτοῦ, καὶ ἐκύκλωσαν ἐν ἀγορᾷ οἱ κοπτόμενοι.

verses.geez: ዘእንበለ፡ ይትገፈታእ፡ ኅብሩ፡ ለብሩር፡ ወይትዌለጥ፡ አስተርእዮቱ፡ ለወርቅ፡ ወይትቀጠቀጥ፡ መስብክት፡ ውስተ፡ ዓዘቅት።
verses.translation: before the silver cord be let go, or the choice gold be broken, or the pitcher be broken at the fountain, or the wheel run down to the cistern;

translations.lxx: before the silver cord be let go, or the choice gold be broken, or the pitcher be broken at the fountain, or the wheel run down to the cistern;
translations.kjv: Or ever the silver cord be loosed, or the golden bowl be broken, or the pitcher be broken at the fountain, or the wheel broken at the cistern.
translations.ron: Mai înainte ca să se rupă funia de argint şi să se spargă vasul de aur şi să se strice ulciorul la izvor şi să se sfărâme roata fântânii,
translations.grk: Ἕως ὅτου μὴ ἀνατραπῇ τὸ σχοινίον τοῦ ἀργυρίου, καὶ συντριβῇ τὸ ἀνθέμιον τοῦ χρυσίου, καὶ συντριβῇ ὑδρία ἐπὶ τῇ πηγῇ, καὶ συντροχάσῃ ὁ τροχὸς ἐπὶ τὸν λάκκον·

verses.geez: ወኀልቃ፡ አዕይንት፡ እለ፡ ያንቀዓድዋ፡ ውስተ፡ መስኮት፡ ወይትዓፀዋ፡ አናቅጸ፡ መራኅብት፡ በእንተ፡ ድንጋፄ፡ ቃላት፡ እለ፡ ይኬልሑ፡ ይትነሥኡ፡ እምቃለ፡ ጸላኢ።
verses.translation: before the dust also return to the earth as it was, and the spirit return to God who gave it.

translations.lxx: before the dust also return to the earth as it was, and the spirit return to God who gave it.
translations.kjv: Then shall the dust return to the earth as it was: and the spirit shall return unto God who gave it.
translations.ron: Şi ca pulberea să se întoarcă în pământ cum a fost, iar sufletul să se întoarcă la Dumnezeu, Care l-a dat.
translations.grk: Καὶ ἐπιστρέψῃ ὁ χοῦς ἐπὶ τὴν γῆν ὡς ἦν, καὶ τὸ πνεῦμα ἐπιστρέψῃ πρὸς τὸν Θεὸν ὃς ἔδωκεν αὐτό.

verses.geez: ወይሌ፡ ላዕለ፡ ኵሉ፡ ደቂቀ፡ አዳም፡ ወይሬእዩ፡ ኀበ፡ ላዕሉ፡ ወይከውን፡ ፍርሃት፡ ውስተ፡ ፍናዋት፡ ወያስተርኢ፡ እሳት፡ ጊዜ፡ ይፈቅድ፡ ተልዕሎተ።
verses.translation: Vanity of vanities, said the Preacher; all is vanity.

translations.lxx: Vanity of vanities, said the Preacher; all is vanity.
translations.kjv: Vanity of vanities, saith the preacher; all is vanity.
translations.ron: Deşertăciunea deşertăciunilor, a zis Ecclesiastul, toate sunt deşertăciuni!
translations.grk: Ματαιότης ματαιοτήτων, εἶπεν ὁ Ἐκκλησιαστὴς, τὰ πάντα ματαιότης.

verses.geez: ወይደምፅ፡ ሰቆቃው፡ ውስተ፡ መራኅብት፡ እምቅድመ፡ ይትወለጥ፡ ኅቡረ፡ ብሩር፡ ወይማስን፡ ሥነ፡ ወርቅ፡ ወያንኰረኵር፡ መንኰራኵር፡ ለኢያንኰርኵሮ፡ ውስተ፡ ዐዘቅት።
verses.translation: And because the Preacher was wise above others, so it was that he taught man excellent knowledge, and the ear will trace out the parables.

translations.lxx: And because the Preacher was wise above others, so it was that he taught man excellent knowledge, and the ear will trace out the parables.
translations.kjv: And moreover, because the preacher was wise, he still taught the people knowledge; yea, he gave good heed, and sought out, and set in order many proverbs.
translations.ron: Şi pe lângă că Ecclesiastul a fost un înţelept, el a mai învăţat pe popor cunoştinţa şi a cercetat şi a privit cu luare aminte şi a cules multe pilde.
translations.grk: Καὶ περισσὸν ὅτι ἐγένετο Ἐκκλησιαστὴς σοφὸς, ὅτι ἐδίδαξε γνῶσιν σὺν τὸν ἄνθρωπον, καὶ οὖς ἐξιχνιάσεται κόσμιον παραβολῶν.

verses.geez: ወይገብእ፡ መሬት፡ ውስተ፡ መሬት፡ ከመ፡ ሀሎ፡ ወመንፈስ፡ ይገብእ፡ ኀበ፡ እግዚአብሔር፡ ዘወሀቦ፡ ወይሁብ፡ አውሥኦ፡ በእንተ፡ ኵሉ፡ ዘገብረ፡ ሊተ፡ አመ፡ ነበረ፡ በሥጋ፡ እመ፡ ኮነ፡ ሠናየ፡ አው፡ እኩየ።
verses.translation: The Preacher sought diligently to find out acceptable words, and a correct writing, even words of truth.

translations.lxx: The Preacher sought diligently to find out acceptable words, and a correct writing, even words of truth.
translations.kjv: The preacher sought to find out acceptable words: and that which was written was upright, even words of truth.
translations.ron: Ecclesiastul s-a străduit să găsească sfaturi folositoare şi îndrumări adevărate şi să le scrie întocmai.
translations.grk: Πολλὰ ἐζήτησεν Ἐκκλησιαστὴς τοῦ εὑρεῖν λόγους θελήματος, καὶ γεγραμμένον εὐθύτητος, λόγους ἀληθείας.

verses.geez: ከንቱ፡ ከንቱ፡ ይቤ፡ መክብብ፡ ኵሉ፡ ከንቱ።
verses.translation: The words of the wise are as goads, and as nails firmly fastened, which have been given from one shepherd by agreement.

translations.lxx: The words of the wise are as goads, and as nails firmly fastened, which have been given from one shepherd by agreement.
translations.kjv: The words of the wise are as goads, and as nails fastened by the masters of assemblies, which are given from one shepherd.
translations.ron: Cuvintele celor înţelepţi sunt ca boldurile de îmboldit dobitoacele şi ca nişte cuie înfipte şi ascuţite şi sunt date de un Păstor.
translations.grk: Λόγοι σοφῶν ὡς τὰ βούκεντρα, καὶ ὡς ἧλοι πεφυτευμένοι, οἳ παρὰ τῶν συνθεμάτων ἐδόθησαν ἐκ ποιμένος ἑνός.

verses.geez: ወፈድፋደ፡ እስመ፡ ኮነ፡ መክብብ፡ ጠቢብ፡ እስመ፡ ይሜህር፡ አእምሮ፡ ኵሎ፡ ሰብአ፡ ወይፈትን፡ ሠርጐ፡ ምስል።
verses.translation: And moreover, my son, guard thyself by means of them: of making many books there is no end; and much study is a weariness of the flesh.

translations.lxx: And moreover, my son, guard thyself by means of them: of making many books there is no end; and much study is a weariness of the flesh.
translations.kjv: And further, by these, my son, be admonished: of making many books there is no end; and much study is a weariness of the flesh.
translations.ron: Şi peste toate acestea, fiul meu, să fii cu luare aminte: scrisul de cărţi este fără sfârşit, iar învăţătura multă este oboseală pentru trup.
translations.grk: Καὶ περισσὸν ἐξ αὐτῶν υἱέ μου φύλαξαι· τοῦ ποιῆσαι βιβλία πολλὰ οὐκ ἔστι περασμὸς, καὶ μελέτη πολλὴ κόπωσις σαρκός.

verses.geez: ኃሠሠ፡ መክብብ፡ ከመ፡ ይርከብ፡ ነገረ፡ ፈቃዱ፡ ወጸሐፈ፡ ርትዐ፡ ወነበበ፡ ጽድቀ።
verses.translation: Hear the end of the matter, the sum: Fear God, and keep his commandments: for this is the whole man.

translations.lxx: Hear the end of the matter, the sum: Fear God, and keep his commandments: for this is the whole man.
translations.kjv: Let us hear the conclusion of the whole matter: Fear God, and keep his commandments: for this is the whole duty of man.
translations.ron: Iată pe scurt; tot ceea ce ai auzit aceasta este: Teme-te de Dumnezeu şi păzeşte poruncile Lui! Acesta este lucru cuvenit fiecărui om.
translations.grk: Τέλος λόγου, τὸ πᾶν ἄκουε· τὸν Θεὸν φοβοῦ, καὶ τὰς ἐντολὰς αὐτοῦ φύλασσε· ὅτι τοῦτο πᾶς ὁ ἄνθρωπος.

verses.geez: ወነገረ፡ ጠቢባን፡ ከመ፡ መድጐጸ፡ ላሕም፡ ወከመ፡ ቅትራት፡ ርሱን፡ እለ፡ እምኀበ፡ ትምህርት፡ ተውህቡ፡ እምአሐዱ፡ ኖላዊ።
verses.translation: For God will bring every work into judgment, with everything that has been overlooked, whether it be good, or whether it be evil.

translations.lxx: For God will bring every work into judgment, with everything that has been overlooked, whether it be good, or whether it be evil.
translations.kjv: For God shall bring every work into judgment, with every secret thing, whether it be good, or whether it be evil.
translations.ron: Căci Dumnezeu va judeca toate faptele ascunse, fie bune, fie rele.
translations.grk: Ὅτι σύμπαν τὸ ποίημα ὁ Θεὸς ἄξει ἐν κρίσει, ἐν παντὶ παρεωραμένῳ, ἐὰν ἀγαθὸν καὶ ἐὰν πονηρόν.

verses.geez: ወፈድፋደሰ፡ እምውስቴቶሙ፡ ወልድየ፡ ኢትግበር፡ መጻሕፍተ፡ ብዙኀ፡ ዘአልቦ፡ ፍጻሜ፡ ወትምህርት፡ ብዙኅ፡ ፃማ፡ ለሥጋ።
ንባበ፡ ኵሉ፡ ነገር፡ ስማዕ፡ ወእግዚአብሔር፡ ፍራሕ፡ ወትእዛዛቲሁ፡ ዕቀብ፡ እስመ፡ ዘውእቱ፡ ኵሉ፡ ሰብእ።
እስመ፡ ኵሎ፡ ፍጥረተ፡ ያቀርብ፡ እግዚአብሔር፡ ለኵነኔ፡ ኵሉ፡ ዘያስተርኢ፡ ወዘኢያስተርኢ፡ እመኒ፡ ሠናይ፡ ወእመኒ፡ እኩይ፡ ውእቱ።
